key_highlights: ASX faces broad selling pressure led by miners, tech de-ratings, and slumped energy shares.
RBA hawkish stance intensifies with rising odds of a fifth rate hike as the inflation outlook worsens.
Aussie flash PMI plunges into contraction territory alongside growth shocks impacting the AUD.
Chinese trade tensions and operational headwinds pressure major iron ore producers including Fortescue.

sectors.trend: Heavy selling in heavyweight iron ore miners due to Chinese trade friction and Pilbara margin compression, partially offset by selective gold exploration activity.
sectors.implications: Downside risk to miner dividends and earnings multiples; defensive rotation toward gold producers.

sectors.trend: Operational retrenchment with Westpac cutting jobs while stress mounts in private credit and property development.
sectors.implications: Rising credit risk provisions and compressed net interest margins as mortgage and development stress worsens.

sectors.trend: Energy shares retreat sharply amid global oil market volatility and an escalating $25b cost blowout at Snowy 2.0.
sectors.implications: Capex inflation and power market volatility raise transition risks and pressure balance sheets.

sectors.trend: Severe de-rating tracking Wall Street losses and project delays at market leader NextDC.
sectors.implications: Multiple contraction across high-beta tech and data centre operators as capital costs rise.

sectors.trend: Sharp pullbacks highlighted by Nick Scali's plunge against nationwide property price declines and cost-of-living constraints.
sectors.implications: Deteriorating household demand weakens retailer margins and corporate revenue forecasts.

sectors.trend: Defensive stability supported by idiosyncratic clinical trial milestones in oncology.
sectors.implications: Offers non-cyclical portfolio cushioning against macroeconomic headwinds.

key_themes: Stagflation risks as domestic flash PMI falls into contraction while RBA hike odds rise.
Geopolitical and demand friction in Chinese iron ore trade squeezing export margins.
Credit tightening and developer distress following private credit stress and falling home prices.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary and REITs; increase cash and floating-rate yields.
Trim pure-play iron ore exposure and diversify into base metals and gold.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private Credit and Property Developer Solvency
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid exposed non-bank lenders and over-leveraged commercial developers.
Hedge exposure to high-valuation tech and infrastructure names facing expansion delays.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate gold miners as safe-haven and inflation hedges
opportunities.rationale: Gold assets provide resilience against AUD growth shocks and broader equity volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to clinical biotechnology assets
opportunities.rationale: High-conviction biotech trial milestones generate uncorrelated alpha during cyclical downturns.

opportunities.recommendation: Opportunistic buying in quality diversified energy producers on dips
opportunities.rationale: Global supply volatility supports long-term operating cash flows despite near-term equities selloff.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to high-cost iron ore producers
defensive_moves.rationale: China trade friction and Pilbara operational cost squeeze degrade near-term earnings quality.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce holdings in consumer cyclicals and capital-intensive tech
defensive_moves.rationale: Falling housing wealth, rate hike pressure, and delivery delays heighten earnings risk.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight major banks exposed to private credit and developer fallout
defensive_moves.rationale: Headcount reductions at Westpac and credit stress point to deteriorating asset quality.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over 1–3 months for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) amid PMI contraction, RBA hawkishness, and mining headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Stabilisation over 6–12 months contingent on rate cycle peaking, though developer debt distress will restrain recovery.
key_catalysts: Next RBA monetary policy meeting and updated inflation forecasts
Developments in Chinese steel mill procurement and trade policies
Quarterly Australian CPI and official GDP prints
Domestic banking updates on bad debt provisions
watch_list: AUD/USD trajectory following macroeconomic growth shocks
Property auction clearance rates and developer defaults
Crude oil volatility and domestic energy transition capex updates
